import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set up paths
input_dir = "./input"
submit_dir = "./submission"

os.makedirs(submit_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "test.csv"))
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(input_dir, "sample_submission.csv"))

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Target column and feature columns
target_col = "species"
feature_pattern = r"^(margin|shape|texture)[_\d]*$"

# Extract features using regex matching
train_feature_cols = sorted(
    [c for c in train_df.columns if re.match(feature_pattern, c) and c != target_col]
)
test_feature_cols = sorted([c for c in test_df.columns if re.match(feature_pattern, c)])

print(f"Training features: {len(train_feature_cols)} columns")
print(f"Test features: {len(test_feature_cols)} columns")

# Get species column names in order matching sample submission
species_cols = list(sample_sub.columns[1:])
n_classes = len(species_cols)
print(f"Number of classes: {n_classes}")

# Create class mapping
class_to_idx = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(species_cols)}
idx_to_class = {idx: cls for cls, idx in class_to_idx.items()}

# Extract features
X_train_raw = train_df[train_feature_cols].values.astype(float)
X_test_raw = test_df[test_feature_cols].values.astype(float)

# Encode target
y_train_encoded = train_df[target_col].map(class_to_idx).values.astype(int)

# Split for genuine hold-out validation (never used for training or hyperparameter tuning)
X_tr_final, X_val_holdout, y_tr, y_val_holdout = train_test_split(
    X_train_raw,
    y_train_encoded,
    test_size=0.15,  # Keep more data for training
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_encoded,
)

# Hyperparameter grid search with cross-validation on training data only
param_grid = {"C": [0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0, 500.0]}

best_cv_logloss = float("inf")
best_params = None
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

for C in param_grid["C"]:
    clf_temp = LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=2000,
        solver="lbfgs",
        multi_class="multinomial",
        C=C,
        penalty="l2",
        random_state=42,
    )

    scores = cross_val_score(clf_temp, X_tr_final, y_tr, cv=5, scoring="neg_log_loss")
    neg_logloss = -scores.mean()

    print(f"C={C}: CV neg_log_loss = {neg_logloss:.6f}")

    if neg_logloss < best_cv_logloss:
        best_cv_logloss = neg_logloss
        best_params = {"C": C}

print(f"\nBest Cross-Validation Multi-Class Log-Loss: {-best_cv_logloss:.6f}")

# Train final model ONLY on training data (NOT including validation set)
clf_final = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    multi_class="multinomial",
    C=best_params["C"],
    random_state=42,
)
clf_final.fit(X_tr_final, y_tr)

# Predict on validation set - no calibration needed since we're computing raw probabilities
val_pred_proba_uncalibrated = clf_final.predict_proba(X_val_holdout)
val_pred_proba_normalized = np.array(
    [
        row / row.sum() if row.sum() > 0 else np.zeros(n_classes)
        for row in val_pred_proba_uncalibrated
    ]
)

# Clip predictions to avoid log domain extremes (as specified in evaluation formula)
val_pred_proba_clipped = np.clip(
    np.maximum(np.minimum(val_pred_proba_normalized, 1), 1e-15), 0, 1
)

# Calculate genuine hold-out logloss AFTER calibration
final_validation_logloss = log_loss(y_val_holdout, val_pred_proba_clipped)
print(f"\nGenuine Hold-Out Validation Log-Loss: {final_validation_logloss:.6f}")

# Predictions on test set with same processing
test_pred_proba_uncalibrated = clf_final.predict_proba(X_test_raw)
test_pred_proba_normalized = np.array(
    [
        row / row.sum() if row.sum() > 0 else np.zeros(n_classes)
        for row in test_pred_proba_uncalibrated
    ]
)

# Clip predictions to avoid log domain extremes
test_pred_proba_clipped = np.clip(
    np.maximum(np.minimum(test_pred_proba_normalized, 1), 1e-15), 0, 1
)

# Generate submission file with exact column order from sample_submission
submission_rows = []
for i in range(len(test_df)):
    row = {"id": int(test_df.iloc[i]["id"])}
    prob_row = test_pred_proba_clipped[i]
    for j, species in enumerate(species_cols):
        row[species] = round(prob_row[j], 6)
    submission_rows.append(row)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_rows)
submission_file_path = os.path.join(submit_dir, "submission.csv")
submission_df.to_csv(submission_file_path, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {submission_file_path}")
print(f"\nFinal Evaluation Metric (Hold-Out Log-Loss): {final_validation_logloss:.6f}")
